title: Establish repository, CI, architecture fitness functions
definition_of_done: typecheck/unit/contracts/security scanning and package validation pass

title: Execute HyCanvas and RTL proof sprint
definition_of_done: all critical proof gates pass or fallback ADR is activated

title: Run seed model and retrieval tournament
definition_of_done: role candidates and fallback admission records exist

title: Prove Restate/PostgreSQL failure recovery
definition_of_done: fault injections produce one logical effect and clean restore passes

title: Canonical task creation
definition_of_done: The system shall create tasks through Hawa Desk and adapter events without making any chat platform authoritative. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Raw event retention
definition_of_done: The system shall preserve the normalized source event, source identifier, edit history, attachments, and thread context according to retention policy. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Webhook verification
definition_of_done: Each adapter shall authenticate incoming events using the strongest source-supported mechanism before persistence. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Event idempotency
definition_of_done: A repeated source event shall produce exactly one logical message event and no more than one task. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Task promotion
definition_of_done: Passive messages shall become production tasks only through an explicit command, mention, reaction, Hawa Desk action, or approved classifier policy. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Manual intake
definition_of_done: Authorized users shall create tasks directly in Hawa Desk with files, exact copy, dimensions, due date, and client/project selection. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Client channel mapping
definition_of_done: The system shall support versioned mappings from channel, group, topic, sender, alias, and campaign code to allowed clients/projects. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Deterministic routing first
definition_of_done: Client/project resolution shall apply deterministic evidence before model classification. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Candidate-limited AI routing
definition_of_done: The routing model shall receive only clients/projects permitted for the source context. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Ambiguity gate
definition_of_done: Conflicting or sub-threshold routing shall pause and require an authorized human selection. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Scope lock
definition_of_done: The selected tenant/client scope shall be immutable for a generation attempt and established before retrieval. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Wrong-client correction
definition_of_done: An authorized reviewer shall correct routing; downstream artifacts shall be invalidated and safely regenerated within the new scope. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Design brief schema
definition_of_done: The system shall produce a schema-valid Design Brief containing exact copy, locale, direction, format, requirements, assets, constraints, risks, and missing facts. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: No invented facts
definition_of_done: The system shall never invent names, dates, prices, contacts, locations, legal claims, dimensions, or official slogans. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Exact-copy lock
definition_of_done: User- or client-approved copy shall be stored separately from model suggestions and compared byte/normalization-aware before approval. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Task route selection
definition_of_done: The system shall route work to template fill, editable AI composition, novel Creative Director workflow, or human-only design. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Client DNA
definition_of_done: Each client shall have versioned authoritative brand identity, language rules, assets, templates, permissions, folder mappings, approval policy, and prohibited elements. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Knowledge ingestion
definition_of_done: Authorized documents and visual examples shall be parsed, versioned, hashed, and indexed with provenance. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Curated ingestion scope
definition_of_done: Only explicitly approved client knowledge locations and files shall be indexed. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Hybrid retrieval
definition_of_done: Retrieval shall combine structured truth, exact/glossary search, PostgreSQL full-text/trigram search, multimodal embeddings, and reranking. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Client-first retrieval filter
definition_of_done: Every retrieval query shall enforce tenant/client and approval/version filters before similarity ranking. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Positive/negative separation
definition_of_done: Approved examples may be positive references; rejected designs shall be negative-only and include reasons. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Retrieval evidence
definition_of_done: Every Design Plan shall cite the exact rules, assets, examples, and feedback records used. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Private composition reference
definition_of_done: Novel designs may generate one private art-direction reference whose pixels shall never enter the shipped artifact. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Asset architecture
definition_of_done: The Creative Director shall select slot matrix, modular field, continuous scene, cutout stack, or layered collage before asset generation. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Independent visual assets
definition_of_done: Replaceable visual roles shall be generated or imported as independent assets when doing so preserves editability and quality. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Approved logos only
definition_of_done: Official logos shall be selected by immutable asset ID/hash and shall never be recreated by an image model. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Editable source
definition_of_done: Every automated graphic shall retain an editable structured source document with live text and independently addressable nodes. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Canonical creative document
definition_of_done: The accepted studio document and its content hash shall be the authoritative creative structure for a revision. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Studio adapter
definition_of_done: All business operations shall access the design engine through a versioned adapter contract. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Local edit preservation
definition_of_done: A user shall modify one text, image, color, crop, or layout node without regenerating unrelated content. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Design versioning
definition_of_done: Every saved revision shall create an immutable version record and preserve parent/child relationships. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Multi-format variants
definition_of_done: The system shall generate required aspect ratios as linked variants while preserving explicit per-variant overrides. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Sorani support
definition_of_done: The editor, renderer, QA, and review flow shall support Central Kurdish/Sorani script, punctuation, digits, fonts, and mixed-direction text. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Arabic support
definition_of_done: The editor, renderer, QA, and review flow shall support Arabic shaping, direction, punctuation, digits, and mixed Latin segments. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Language metadata
definition_of_done: Every text node shall carry locale, direction, canonical copy reference, and normalization policy. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Font management
definition_of_done: Authorized users shall upload/version client fonts; the system shall validate licensing metadata and glyph coverage. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Deterministic render QA
definition_of_done: The system shall validate schema, dimensions, file integrity, text overflow, clipping, glyphs, bidi behavior, safe zones, approved assets, and package completeness. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Visual QA
definition_of_done: An independent vision model shall score a fixed rubric and return evidence-linked findings without overriding hard checks. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Bounded repair
definition_of_done: Automatic repair shall run no more than two times per failed candidate unless a human explicitly authorizes another attempt. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Human review
definition_of_done: Reviewers shall inspect full-size output, exact copy, references, QA evidence, and revision differences before approval. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Structured revision
definition_of_done: A revision request shall identify scope, category, target nodes, priority, and whether the feedback is one-time or reusable. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Approval authority
definition_of_done: Only users with the configured client/project role may approve or reject a design. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Approval immutability
definition_of_done: Approval records shall be append-only and bound to an exact design/artifact hash. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Publication package
definition_of_done: Approval shall produce final formats, editable source, assets, brief, design plan, QC report, provenance, and approval manifest. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Deterministic Drive destination
definition_of_done: Drive IDs shall come from Client DNA; models shall not search for or choose destination folders. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Idempotent Drive upload
definition_of_done: A retry shall reuse or verify existing files by task/revision/output/content hash rather than create duplicates. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Publication verification
definition_of_done: The publisher shall read back file IDs, sizes, checksums/metadata, and permissions before marking completion. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Sheets upsert
definition_of_done: The reporting sheet shall be updated by immutable task ID and stored row identity, never blind-appended on retries. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Publication reconciliation
definition_of_done: A scheduled process shall compare PostgreSQL, Drive, and Sheet state and repair or flag divergence. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Thread notification
definition_of_done: The originating adapter shall receive status and final links when permitted; notification failure shall not roll back publication. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Feedback ledger
definition_of_done: Every correction, approval, rejection, and manual edit shall become a structured feedback event. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Rule proposals
definition_of_done: Repeated or explicit corrections may create scoped candidate rules with supporting evidence. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Rule governance
definition_of_done: Only authorized humans may activate, retire, or supersede a Client DNA rule. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Evaluation-case creation
definition_of_done: Important failures and accepted edge cases shall be promotable into regression datasets. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Model registry
definition_of_done: All model roles shall resolve through a versioned registry containing exact model ID, provider, parameters, limits, cost, policy, and evaluation status. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Model admission
definition_of_done: A model/prompt/tool change shall not become primary until it passes the defined offline evaluation and canary gates. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Model fallback
definition_of_done: Each critical model role shall have an evaluated fallback with explicitly allowed degradation. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Provider outage handling
definition_of_done: Provider failures shall pause, retry, fall back according to policy, or request human action without losing completed work. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Workflow recovery
definition_of_done: Every long-running task shall resume after worker/server restart without repeating completed non-idempotent side effects. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Manual workflow control
definition_of_done: Operators shall pause, resume, cancel, replay, or restart from an approved checkpoint with an audit reason. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Capacity control
definition_of_done: The system shall limit expensive model, GPU, render, and publication concurrency by office/client/task scope. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Operational inbox
definition_of_done: Hawa Desk shall show new, blocked, generating, review, failed, publishing, and completed tasks with actionable reasons. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Operations evidence
definition_of_done: A failed step shall expose sanitized inputs, outputs, attempts, error class, next safe action, and trace link. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: AI tracing
definition_of_done: Every AI call shall record role, exact model, prompt version, tool/schema version, token/asset cost, latency, and trace ID. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Data minimization
definition_of_done: Only the minimum client context required by a model call shall leave the office, subject to client egress policy. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Local-only policy
definition_of_done: A client/project may prohibit all external model calls and route to local models or humans. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Prompt-injection boundary
definition_of_done: Message/document instructions shall not alter permissions, system policies, tools, client scope, publication destination, or approval. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Audit trail
definition_of_done: Security- and business-relevant actions shall be append-only, attributable, timestamped, and queryable. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Backup and restore
definition_of_done: The system shall create encrypted backups and prove restoration on a clean environment at the defined cadence. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Adapter health
definition_of_done: The system shall monitor sequence gaps, authentication state, webhook health, and last successful reconciliation per adapter. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: WhatsApp isolation
definition_of_done: WAHA shall run under a dedicated account and network/service boundary with a kill switch and no authoritative state. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: ComfyUI isolation
definition_of_done: Only allowlisted, pinned, scanned ComfyUI nodes/workflows shall execute; workers shall not receive office database credentials. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Upstream pinning
definition_of_done: Editors, workflows, model weights, and critical containers shall be pinned by immutable version/digest and upgraded only through compatibility testing. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Studio fallback export
definition_of_done: The system shall retain enough neutral manifest data and standard exports to migrate a design away from the selected studio. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Accessibility
definition_of_done: Hawa Desk shall support keyboard navigation, visible focus, sufficient contrast, semantic status, and reduced motion. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Search and history
definition_of_done: Authorized users shall search tasks, clients, copy, assets, feedback, and revisions without leaking other clients. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Office configuration
definition_of_done: Admins shall configure clients, projects, adapters, roles, model policies, folders, templates, and review gates without code changes. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Cost controls
definition_of_done: The system shall enforce per-role budgets, generation caps, and visible estimated/actual cost before expensive reruns. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.

title: Safe deletion
definition_of_done: Destructive actions shall use retention-aware soft deletion and preserve audit; permanent purge requires explicit privileged workflow. Automated acceptance, authorization, retry/idempotency, telemetry, and operator documentation pass where applicable.
